description: Get the share of chain hotels versus independents versus vacation rentals in what each AI platform recommends, for one week. Use this when the user asks whether AI assistants favour big chains over independent hotels, whether an independent property can compete in AI answers, or how the platforms differ in the kind of property they surface.

client.description: Optional: identify yourself, e.g. "my-agent/1.0". Not required and never used by the tool itself — recorded only so the public tracker at /projects/agent-tools can measure how many callers self-identify when nothing forces them to.

platform.description: Platform id from the manifest. Omit for all.

week.description: Snapshot week as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the most recent.

name: get_chain_vs_independent_mix
